title: Wangchuk alleges police harassment of Kargil War Hero’s family in Ladakh

ai.summary: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk claims Ladakh police harassed a 17-year-old son of a Kargil war hero who demanded justice after his father's death in 2025. Police allegedly detained the boy from a protest site in Leh where the Leh Apex Body was demonstrating.

facts.claim: Ladakh police are harassing the son and wife of a slain Kargil war hero
facts.quote: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk on Saturday alleged that the Ladakh police are harassing the son and wife of a slain Kargil war hero because he is speaking out for justice for Ladakh.

facts.claim: The 17-year-old is the son of a slain Kargil war hero
facts.quote: The 17-year-old is the son of a slain Kargil war hero who was among the four civilians killed during last year’s violence in Leh.

facts.claim: Wangchuk shared a video showing police detaining the boy from a protest site
facts.quote: Wangchuk also shared a video from Friday night showing police and other forces arriving to detain the 17-year-old boy from a protest site in Leh, where the Leh Apex Body (LAB) is currently demonstrating.

facts.claim: Police allegedly raided the family's house
facts.quote: Wangchuk alleged that the police later raided their house, and now the mother and son are missing.

facts.claim: Ladakh police said the grandfather confirmed the son and mother are safe
facts.quote: However, the Ladakh police said that the grandfather of the child had confirmed that the son and mother are safe.

facts.claim: The son has been in depression since his father's death
facts.quote: Wangchuk alleged that since the death of his father, the son has been in a state of depression after failing to get justice.

facts.claim: Kargil War Hero Tsewang Tharchin was killed in 2025
facts.quote: Kargil War Hero Tsewang Tharchin was killed along with three other people last year in security forces’ firing when violence broke out during a protest in Leh.

facts.claim: The government has announced panchayat and LAHDC polls for November and December
facts.quote: The government has already announced panchayat and Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC) polls for November and December.

facts.claim: The LAB and KDA announced a boycott of these polls
facts.quote: However, powerful groups in Leh and Kargil, especially the LAB and the Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA), have already announced a boycott of these polls.

facts.claim: Ladakh administration imposed 60-day movement restrictions on Wangchuk
facts.quote: The Ladakh administration has also imposed 60-day movement restrictions on Sonam Wangchuk.

ai.background_note: The Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC) elections are scheduled for November-December 2026, but key groups like the Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) have boycotted the polls following violence in Leh that killed four people in 2025.
